I’ll treat this as a focused code-review audit, not a fix. I’m using the plan-execution-graph skill because you explicitly requested parallel issue-type checks; I’ll also do the required lightweight Keating memory pass, then verify findings against the actual worktree and targeted checks.

The orchestration skill makes one useful constraint explicit here: this is a read-only review DAG, so agents will own disjoint rubric categories and produce evidence, while I keep integration and validation local. The first wave will cover refactoring, duplication, and dependency management; later waves will reuse the same reviewers for the remaining categories.
